meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会扫描项目找出未使用的代码,验证确认无用后,派多个代理并行分批删除,每批单独提交,最后运行检查确保项目正常。不删除入口文件、测试文件等受保护代码。
howto.when: 当你说“移除死代码”“清理”“删除未使用代码”等,要求清理项目中无用代码时触发。

say.text: 清理这个项目里的无用代码
say.note: Claude 会扫描并移除确认无用的代码。

say.text: 删除 src 下没被用到的函数和类型
say.note: Claude 会只扫描 src 目录并移除无用代码。

say.text: 只清理 utils 目录里的死代码
say.note: Claude 会只在 utils 内查找并删除死代码。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude scans for unused code, verifies via LSP, then dispatches parallel agents to remove it in separate atomic commits. Afterwards it runs typecheck and build. Entry points, tests, and public exports are never removed.
howto.when_en: Triggered by phrases like 'remove dead code', 'cleanup', 'remove unused', or similar requests to clear unused code from the project.

say_en.text: Clean up unused code in this project.
say_en.note: Claude will scan and remove confirmed dead code.

say_en.text: Delete unused functions and types in src.
say_en.note: Claude will scan src only and remove unused code.

say_en.text: Only clean dead code in the utils directory.
say_en.note: Claude will limit its search to utils and delete dead code.
